digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and manifest encoding
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic pin per direct child and prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID.
Plan material pins must contain the target's canonical ticket ID, role (child or prerequisite), and exact 16-hex material_fingerprint(PlanContext) value from the target ticket.
PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived tickets to discover inbound blockers, then collect outgoing and inbound relations before any LLM evaluation.

Any unreadable, unresolvable, or deleted target must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with a structured PlanRelationSnapshotError before any LLM call, with reason from the enum {missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure}.

tracker_head_sha() must verify a clean tickets-tracker state via git status and git ls-files -u, then return the 40-hex SHA from git rev-parse HEAD, mapping all git/IO/path/subprocess failures to store-read-failure.

All plan-review signing paths (ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must collect complete pins via collect_plan_relation_snapshot() and pass them to build_manifest(), with legacy manifests lacking pins remaining readable by ignoring additive pin lines.
